article.headline: Drayton Jones scores 34 to lead South Carolina State over Charleston Southern 82-63
article.description: — Drayton Jones scored 34 points to lead South Carolina State over Charleston Southern 82-63 on Monday night.
article.linkText: Drayton Jones scores 34 to lead South Carolina State over Charleston Southern 82-63

article.story: ORANGEBURG, S.C. -- — Drayton Jones scored 34 points to lead South Carolina State over Charleston Southern 82-63 on Monday night. Jones also contributed eight rebounds and six blocks for the Bulldogs (5-6). Davion Everett had nine points and Caleb McCarty scored eight. Taje' Kelly led the way for the Buccaneers (3-9) with 25 points and 10 rebounds. Reis Jones added 15 points and seven rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
